title: Finite clock-host machine
statement: Given a finite deterministic Turing machine $S$ over the Boolean alphabet, a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $A$ over the Boolean alphabet, and a Boolean parameter specifying whether to loop, define a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with $S.k+A.k+1$ work tapes. Its states are clock phases associated with the states of $S$ and $A$, and its transitions are those of the clock-host construction from $S$, $A$, and the loop parameter.
hypotheses_covered: A finite deterministic Turing machine $S$ over the Boolean alphabet
A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $A$ over the Boolean alphabet
